headline: Weathered Expanse Flips Multiply as Kuura Strand and Fishermans Erupt
war_summary: Combat has reignited sharply across Weathered Expanse, where ferocious exchanges around Wightwalk and Crow's Nest drove massive casualty surges and multiple structural turnovers over the past six hours. In Callahan's Passage, total Warden dominance slipped as Crumbling Post was battered into neutral no-man's-land amid relentless bloodshed. Intense regional clashes have newly erupted along the coastlines and islands: Kuura Strand registered a flurry of base contests at Martti and Menneen, while Fisherman's Row saw heavy fighting rotate control over Oceanwatch and Peripti Landing. Farther inland, casualty tallies escalated drastically in Mooring County, where MacConmara Barrows was reduced to rubble, and throughout Marban Hollow, where thousands fell in recent hours. Nevish Line remains evenly fractured between both armies around Grief Mother, whereas earlier southern and western flashpoints in Palantine Berm, Stonecradle, and Stlican Shelf have largely settled into quieter standstills.
